title: It's ok, but extremely hard to unsubscribe, so beware!
body:
Tried the app, hoping it would be motivating but found it was too cumbersome and took too long to use. So I tried to cancel it before the free trial was up. 

Could find NO way to cancel it. My PayPal account was charged $39.99 USD which in itself is an astronomical amount for an app. In the app it says I'm still using the free version and can upgrade to premium. Tried to follow their in-app instructions to cancel my subscription but the app does not appear in my iCloud subscriptions in order to cancel.

I had to click a link in their billing info to cancel my subscription and hopefully it will work.

Definitely too much hassle to unsubscribe and it feels like a giant scam. 

Do check some other reviews online amd DO NOT get the free trial, as you'll be charged forever and stuck with it. Not worth it.
